name: Studio rejects an empty or one-character brief without navigating away
description: Submitting the Studio brief form with an empty or too-short brief shows an error toast and does not start outline generation.

planSteps.description: Navigate to the app root URL / and stay on the default 'Studio — structured' tab so the create workbench is visible.
Leave the brief textarea empty and click the 'Forge the outline' button.
Verify an error toast appears telling the user to describe what the presentation should be about, and the page does NOT navigate to an outline view.
Type a single character 'a' into the brief textarea and click 'Forge the outline' again.
Verify the same error feedback appears again and the page still does not navigate to an outline view.
Now type a real brief: 'Quarterly business review for a logistics company covering on-time delivery, cost per shipment and safety' into the brief textarea.
Verify the 'Forge the outline' button becomes enabled.
